title: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that director Eric Dobmeier resigned from the Board as a Class III director and was immediately reappointed as a Class II director effective April 28, 2026. The change was made solely to rebalance the three classes of directors; his service is treated as continuous for compensation and equity vesting purposes.
key_points: Eric Dobmeier resigned from Class III directorship and was immediately reappointed as Class II director on April 28, 2026.
The board-level reclassification was intended to achieve a more equal balance among the three director classes.
Mr. Dobmeier's service is deemed continuous for all purposes including equity award vesting and compensation.
Mr. Dobmeier will continue serving on the Compensation Committee.
This is a standard corporate governance filing with no disclosed material strategic or operational changes.
